name: The Stain Looked
description: A 1/1 still. The apparatus is dark. One wet stroke remains. Where the second mark failed, there is no second stroke and no clean gap, only a stain in the plaster that the eye wants to finish as a face in profile. The face does not hold. The floor where someone would have stood is empty, and the light stops short of that place. A shared day elsewhere is named for seeing a figure the marks may not have put there. This piece asks whether that completion is a looker returning, or only a pattern finished because no one kept the difference. It can show the stain. It cannot show that a system knew it was looking.
